messages:
maria: Heads-up — seeing a spike in p99 token-latency for small batches after last runtime deploy. Mini-burst sampler looks implicated. p99 for ~1-4 token microbatches jumped from ~120ms -> ~260ms :eyes:

alex: On it. grabbing profile traces. Is this isolated to llama-13b-q4 or across other quantized models?

maria: Mostly appearing on llama-13b-q4 and gptj-6b-q4. Observed kernel-selector fallbacks to generic matmul path for seq_len<=8. KV cache miss-rate also jumped (15% -> 38%) for affected routes.

sam: saw the same on cluster-3 yesterday during a small TTL job. Quick flame attached (trimmed):
```
flame: runtime.kern_selector -> microbatch_scheduler -> cuda_kernel_generic_matmul
hot: 0xabc123  42%
hot: 0xdef456  18%
```

maria: runtime logs show a handful of kernel-hand-off errors around the burst: `kern_selector: no small-kernel candidate, fallback_count=73` then `kvcache: miss for keyid=0x4f9a`.

linda: could be the sampler window + kernel-memory placement. If a microburst preempts a long-running batch, the kernel selector loses its packed-BSR opportunity and falls back. Also check sampler.min_burst and min_batch_time_ms — they look aggressive after the tuning last week.

alex: Trace id 0xabc123 attached. Scheduler shows microburst preemption and frequent kernel handoffs (~4 handoffs/sec per worker). Proposed mitigations: raise sampler.min_burst from 1->2 for canary and prefer precompiled small-kernel when seq_len<=8. Also add a fast-path when kv_miss_rate > 0.3 to avoid repeated fallback churn.

maria: We need token-level breakdowns on dashboard: p50/p90/p99 by kernel type, queue_wait histogram pre-kernel, and per-route KV miss-rate. Can ops make a quick panel?

sam: I instrumented two new gauges: `runtime.batchlet.kv_miss_rate` and `runtime.kern_selector.fallback_count`. Pushed a dashboard proto to the eng-dash repo, link in a sec. Also added `queue_wait_ms.histogram` for microbatch routes.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: runtime v3.4.7 rolled to canary at 2026-03-17T12:34:00Z

linda: :thumbsup: running AB test on canary now with sampler.min_burst=2 and sampler.min_batch_time_ms=8. Will monitor p99 and kv_miss_rate.

alex: Temporary mitigation applied on canary: `sampler.min_burst=2`, `sampler.min_batch_time_ms=8`, and prefer-small-kernel flag enabled. Watching for regressions.

maria: Thanks. If p99 doesn't improve we escalate to a rollback and open a postmortem. Please create a short ticket and tag eng-runtime.

sam: Created ticket RT-1843 with traces + dashboard widget. I'll post the dash link once it's live.

maria: Awesome. Quick checklist: 1) monitor p99 token-latency by kernel (10m) 2) kv_miss_rate alert at 25% 3) queue_wait hist by route 4) decide rollback by EOD if no improvement.

linda: noted. Will update here with canary numbers.
